verdict_template.unassured: Nothing is visibly wrong; we are still building checks for {unassured} of the {total} areas, and the plans for those are written.
verdict_template.ok: The look is holding, and what checks it runs on every page load.

goals.statement: Rights on record for every art, sound and font asset
goals.why_it_matters: The rights we rely on came from a vendor whose terms are undated and can be revoked in place, so a clearance cannot stand forever. And what we owe is owed to whoever made the work — a public build is where we owe it.

measure.label: the credits file, and your own reading of the vendor's terms

members.unit: shipped file with no record of where it came from
members.unit_plural: shipped files with no record of where they came from

members.note: Retro Diffusion's output rights were read against their legal terms and cleared for commercial release. Their terms are undated and revocable in place, so this expires and has to be re-read rather than standing forever.

path_to_green.narrative: Re-read the vendor's terms, and any licence that came with an asset added since the last check.

action.label: Put it on the VP of Design's list
action.title: Re-read the art vendor's terms and credit what is missing
action.ask: Either a shipped file has no record of where it came from, or the reading of the vendor's terms has aged past its expiry. Credit every file that is missing from CREDITS.md, re-read the vendor's terms as they stand today, and bring the result back for the CEO to sign.
action.first_action: Run the orphan-file check behind this goal to list the uncredited files, then open the vendor's terms page.

escalates.because: What we owe here is owed to whoever made the work, and a public build is where we owe it.
